name: prometeus-ru
description: Physical-key mapping between English (Prometeus) and Russian (ЙЦУКЕН). Keys map by xkb position (AD01..AB10).
notes: Digits 0-9 unchanged (same physical position in both layouts).
LSGT key (prometeus: r/R) has no ru equivalent — skipped.
Shift+B in ru gives ',' (comma) — used for the punctuation position.
